final: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) as record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation sc2 INNER JOIN sites s2 ON sc2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) as fraction FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, (CASE WHEN s.insurstat IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC LIMIT 10
